title: Director of Plant Operations
text:
***Join Nicopress — a stable, successful Cleveland-based global manufacturer with nearly 125 years of innovation in connectivity solutions.***

**Lead People. Improve Processes. Make an Impact.**

*Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives on improving operations, developing people, and getting results?* Nicopress is looking for an experienced **Director of Plant Operations** to lead our manufacturing operations and help take our performance to the next level.

This is an opportunity to make a real impact in a stable, established manufacturing company where your ideas, leadership, and contributions will be noticed and valued.

What You'll Do

* Lead daily manufacturing operations, ensuring safety, quality, efficiency, and on-time delivery.
* Coach and develop production supervisors while building a culture of accountability and teamwork.
* Champion the effective use and optimization of our MRP system to strengthen production planning and inventory management.
* Drive continuous improvement, reduce waste, and improve operational performance.
* Partner closely with senior leadership, engineering, and quality teams to solve problems and move the business forward.

What We're Looking For

* 8–10+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Proven success leading production teams and developing supervisors.
* Strong hands-on experience with MRP/ERP systems, production planning, and process improvement.
* A practical, solutions-oriented leader who is equally comfortable on the production floor and collaborating with leadership.
* Experience in precision manufacturing, metalworking, or machining is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

What we offer:

* Competitive salary of $50-60k based on experience.
* Work/life balance with a Mon-Fri 8:15 to 4:45 work schedule & no overtime required.
* Full benefits package, including generous paid time off.

**Why Nicopress?**

At Nicopress, you'll enjoy the opportunity to make meaningful improvements without layers of corporate bureaucracy. We're a close-knit manufacturing organization of approximately 50 employees that values quality, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you're ready to roll up your sleeves, lead a great team, and make a visible difference, we'd love to hear from you!**

Full job description available upon request or interview. Work with us!

*Nicopress is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Pay: $110,000.00 - $145,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Plant management: 5 years (Required)
* Manufacturing: 8 years (Required)
* MRP/ERP systems: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
